item.title: Claude?
item.body: Removing all Claude models without saying anything is honestly embarassing. This is not acceptable.

The TRAE platform has recently completed the update of its built-in models. Due to the interruption of the Claude series model service, we will suspend the built-in access to the Claude series. We are full of confidence in the future. Based on core models such as GPT-5, Gemini 2.5-Pro, Kimi-K2-0905, and DeepSeek V3.1-Terminus, combined with TRAE's in-depth optimization in inference quality, code intelligence, and execution chain, You can still enjoy the same high-quality product performance as before. We will also continue to enhance the capabilities of our products to provide users with an experience that surpasses the past. To express our gratitude for your support and understanding, from now until January 31, 2026, the number of "Fast Queue" requests for Pro members will increase by 50%, with an additional 300 requests per month. For any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact: feedback@mail.trae.ai

No one cares about an extra 300 “Fast Queue” requests when you’ve stripped out the only models that made this platform worth paying for. Claude was the reason I subscribed in the first place, and without it, there’s zero reason to keep paying.
If you ever bring Claude back, maybe I’ll reconsider. Until then, this is a hard no.

> > Вы должны шутить. Удаление всех моделей Клода без какого-либо предупреждения абсолютно неприемлемо. Это не «обновление обслуживания», это понижение рейтинга и пощечина людям, которые фактически заплатили за качество. Никто не заботится о дополнительных 300 запросах «Быстрая очередь», когда вы убрали единственные модели, которые сделали эту платформу достойной оплаты. Клод был причиной, по которой я подписался в первую очередь, и без этого нет причин продолжать платить. Если вы когда-нибудь вернете Клода, возможно, я пересмотрю. До тех пор, это трудное «нет».
> 
> В настоящее время модели Клода переоценены. У вас есть четкие примеры из Cursor и Windsurf, где они используют китайские модели с открытым исходным кодом, такие как Composer или SWE 1.5. Для меня это логичный вариант устранения моделей Antropic; они дороги и не предлагают явного преимущества перед другими моделями. Просто они очень хорошо продают себя, и мы считаем, что они единственная стоящая модель.

Are claude's models overrated?
Sonnet 4.5 - writes code so much more powerful than GPT of any version that it's ridiculous. I bought a TRAE subscription for a year because of sonnet 4, but when I didn't see sonnet 4.5 and when all sonnet models disappeared after a short time, it became a serious reason for a refund, 300 additional requests for a couple of months? Really? I spent 200 requests to fix 2 objects, sonnet 4.5 in cursor fixed it in 1 request.

AFAIK.
Anthropic, the company that owns Claude, is restricting Chinese companies' access to its AI.

> Removing all Claude models without saying anything is honestly embarassing. This is not acceptable.

OMG, I wish I could... Claude haiku writes 5 .md files every time it changes a single line of code, and sonnet uses such deprecated code for frameworks I spend more time fixing its mistakes than actually moving forward in my coding. `Manage Models` allows you to hide them but even if you go into the settings.json and ban the current ones as deprecated Copilot Chat will still default to one of these broken pieces of billing increases. If these LLMs weren't so broken they might be worth using. How do I repeat this problem so I can get rid of them on my system?
